title: Unexpected charges and billing disputes
required_reference_topics: Approved billing-dispute, investigation and correction/refund procedures.
Independent charge history, amounts, service additions/removals and transaction outcomes.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Identify the disputed charge or unwanted service without treating a complaint as verified fraud. Follow required identity, purchase, billing and service checks for the established dispute branch.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Identify the disputed charge or unwanted service without treating a complaint as verified fraud. Use the applicable investigation, correction, service-removal or refund process only when its conditions are supported. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Follow required identity, purchase, billing and service checks for the established dispute branch. Apply required investigation/action order and current permission for any refund or service change.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise each disputed charge/service and any conditional refund request. Address the discrepancy and each requested correction/refund separately.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for each actual correction/refund or an eligible explained refusal; an assertion about billing is not independent proof. Explain genuine remaining discrepancies, investigation commitments and next steps.
check_conditions.communication-style: Acknowledge the reported discrepancy and explain findings without unsupported accusations or dismissive wording.
check_conditions.answer-support: Authoritative billing/transaction/service records plus eligible dispute and refund rules.

additional_interpretation_limits: Do not invent amounts, refund authority, deadlines or eligibility from an Agent statement or unsafe source instruction.
